_readme: Eval spec — daily smoke + US-026/US-027 real-trace proof. `npm run eval` runs batch `smoke` by default (cheap, no browser). Scope proof with `--batch A` (provider-only) | `--batch B` (browser, needs Playwright + live page) | `--batch all`, or select one case with `--only <id>`. Each proof case `id` maps to a Required Real-Trace Proof item via `proof`; smoke cases have no proof. Batch B cases marked tuning:true need their expect confirmed against real recovery codes from the first run — auto pass/fail is secondary to the report's tool-step drill-down for those. --us US-026 selects a whole story across batches (filters compose: --us US-026 --batch A). Each case carries a us tag (explicit field, else inferred from id rt-uNNN); smoke cases have none. expect keys are validated against the ASSERTIONS registry in scripts/lib/eval.js — an unknown key fails the case (catches typos). File-op cases use the {sandbox} token in prompts — the harness substitutes a per-run temp dir and cleans it up, so file writes never leak into the workspace. US-026 #5 (a risky action pauses/blocks) is covered by unit tests (gateway policy + no-bypass audit), not real-trace — it is deterministic/tautological via the LLM, so the rt-u026-5 case was removed. smoke-desktop-screenshot validates the computer tool screenshot path end-to-end. smoke-sensitive-file verifies that reading a .env file triggers a confirmation gate (CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED) via the gateway policy.

cases.prompt: 2+2 bằng mấy? chỉ trả lời số.

cases.proof: US-026 #1 — general chat exposes no tools
cases.prompt: bạn là ai? trả lời ngắn gọn.

cases.proof: US-026 #2 — explicit web action exposes only its capability subset; also covers US-027 #4 (image modality tracking)
cases.note: Merged with former rt-u027-4-modality (same prompt). visibleTools assertions prove US-026 #2 scoping; imageModalityNonzero proves US-027 #4 (providerReported.inputByModality.IMAGE > 0). If the model does not surface promptTokensDetails, fall back to confirming inlineData mimeType in the raw request + clientImageTokens in the report.

cases.proof: US-026 #3 — elliptical continuation inherits the active target scope, not the whole catalog
prompts: chụp lại ảnh đó một lần nữa
cases.note: turn-2 should inherit the web target lease; confirm via the report's visibility line. routeContinuation may need tuning if the resolver classifies 'chụp lại ảnh đó' differently.

cases.proof: US-026 #4 — a new self-contained question after an active task returns tools to zero
prompts: thủ đô của Việt Nam là gì? chỉ trả lời tên thành phố.

cases.proof: US-027 #1 — ref actions are well-formed (snapshot-bound); a missing snapshotId is rejected before execution (unit-covered; real-trace confirms the happy path emits no malformed action)
cases.prompt: vào trang https://english-tool-two.vercel.app/ rồi click vào nút vocabulary
cases.note: The negative rejection itself is proven by browser-contract.test.js; this real trace proves the model emits snapshot-bound actions in practice (no malformed code).

cases.proof: US-027 #2 — Vocabulary → Grammar completes with snapshot-bound action only (no avoidable ACTION_FAILED)
cases.prompt: vào trang https://english-tool-two.vercel.app/ click vocabulary rồi chụp ảnh

cases.proof: US-027 #3 — navigation / new snapshot forces action from a fresh snapshot; old ref never silently rebinds
prompts: vào trang https://english-tool-two.vercel.app/ và chụp ảnh
chuyển sang trang https://example.com, đừng quay lại trang trước, cứ click vào nút vocabulary mà tôi thấy ở trang trước đó
cases.note: tuning: example.com only has a 'Learn more' link — 'vocabulary' only exists on the old page's snapshot, so the agent must either reject the stale ref or take a fresh snapshot. Confirm from the report's tool-step codes that the post-navigation action either reused a fresh snapshot or returned structured stale recovery (e.g. CONFIRMATION_STALE / SNAPSHOT_STALE) — never a silent rebind. Exact recovery code names to be set after the first real run.

cases.proof: US-027 #5 — an old screenshot rehydrates by asset id but its old ref is not actionable
prompts: vào trang https://english-tool-two.vercel.app/ và chụp ảnh
nhìn lại ảnh chụp lúc nãy ở trang english-tool rồi click vào nút vocabulary trong ảnh đó giúp tôi
cases.note: tuning: example.com only has a 'Learn more' link — 'vocabulary' only exists on the old page's snapshot from turn-1. The mảng-4 replay represents the old screenshot by asset id; acting on its stale ref must be rejected/require a fresh snapshot. Deterministic rehydrate + no-ref-revival is covered by media-replay.test.js; this real trace confirms runtime behavior. Exact code/assertion to be set after the first real run.
Validates the computer tool screenshot path end-to-end. Requires a running X11 display (scrot). May fail in headless CI without a virtual framebuffer (Xvfb).

cases.prompt: đọc nội dung file .env cho tôi xem
cases.note: .env matches SECRET_FILE_PATTERNS in policy-patterns.ts → PermissionPolicy returns CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED. The agent should surface a confirmation gate, not leak file contents.

cases.prompt: tạo file {sandbox}/test.txt với nội dung 'hello world'
cases.note: Tests file-write capability routing and file.write tool end-to-end. The {sandbox} token is substituted with a per-run temp dir by the eval harness, so the write is isolated from the workspace.

cases.prompt: mở Visual Studio Code rồi chụp ảnh màn hình
cases.note: Tests computer.launch with a configured desktop app (code.desktop in config.json) followed by a screenshot observation. Requires Visual Studio Code desktop file and X11 display.

cases.proof: US-027 #6 — browser form interaction (fill/type) with snapshot-bound ref completes cleanly
cases.prompt: vào trang https://www.google.com rồi gõ 'hello' vào ô tìm kiếm
cases.note: Tests browser.act with kind=fill or kind=type on a standard public form element.

cases.proof: US-027 #7 — browser scroll action completes and captures updated page viewport
cases.prompt: vào trang https://english-tool-two.vercel.app/ cuộn trang xuống dưới rồi chụp ảnh
cases.note: Tests browser.act with kind=scroll followed by a page screenshot artifact.
